text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One effective method is using SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. Breaking a project into milestones helps the team track progress and stay motivated. It is also important to define deliverables clearly, so everyone knows what needs to be completed. Finally, stakeholder alignment ensures that everyone involved shares the same expectations from the start. When these elements are combined, projects run more smoothly, and teams are more likely to achieve their objectives on time and within budget.
